verdict.rationale: Steel documents its own Files API ('Explore API Endpoints for managing Files on Steel'), which points to a first-party way to manage file artifacts. However, the evidence never explains whether agents can upload files to sites or capture downloads during a session, or how those files are retrieved afterwards. Screenshot/PDF export and trace ZIP exports are adjacent features and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented in-session file upload to sites, documented capture of browser downloads, documented retrieval of artifacts after the session ends, any hands-on or independent corroboration.
